color.note: Two themes. Veil is the game. High contrast is an added accessibility theme: solid panels, brighter accents, 3:1 frames. Colour always travels with a shape or a word: allies are circles, enemies diamonds, queued things hatched.

tokens.name: teal-500
tokens.usage: Primitive. Brand teal: allies and the CTA. Use through `ally` or `cta`, not directly.

tokens.name: teal-300
tokens.usage: Primitive. Light teal for ally text and the CTA gradient's far end. Use through `ally-text`, `cta-2`, `heal`.

tokens.name: lavender-500
tokens.usage: Primitive. Brand lavender: the shared Power resource. Use through `power`.

tokens.name: lavender-300
tokens.usage: Primitive. Light lavender for Power numbers and labels. Use through `power-text`.

tokens.name: crimson-400
tokens.usage: Primitive. Brand crimson: enemies and danger. Use through `enemy`, `danger-zone`, `badge-new`.

tokens.name: crimson-300
tokens.usage: Primitive. Light crimson for enemy names and numbers. Use through `enemy-text`.

tokens.name: ember-400
tokens.usage: Primitive. Warm ember: character rim light in lobby and team scenes. Use through `scene-rim`.

tokens.name: amber-400
tokens.usage: Primitive. Warning amber (latency 120 ms+, unstable link). Use through `warn`.

tokens.name: orange-400
tokens.usage: Primitive. Prop orange: where a shot stops on breakable cover. Use through `prop-hit`.

tokens.name: cyan-200
tokens.usage: Primitive. Pale cyan for barriers and shields. Use through `barrier`.

tokens.name: cyan-400
tokens.usage: Primitive. Projection cyan: the loader trace and the contrast theme's holo frames (the veil theme draws its holo accents in teal since the main-menu concept). Never a ground or panel colour.

tokens.name: dark-50
tokens.usage: Primitive. Warm dark violet: raised controls and the centre of menu backdrops. Use through `raised`.

tokens.name: dark-100
tokens.usage: Primitive. Near-black plum: menu backdrop mid-tone and deep wells.

tokens.name: dark-300
tokens.usage: Primitive. The void: behind the arena and every screen. Use through `ground`.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The page and void behind the 3D scene. Every preview and menu screen starts here.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: HUD and menu panels: 86% solid over the scene, never blurred. The ground for `text`, `text-2`, `text-3` and every `*-text` colour.

tokens.name: panel-solid
tokens.usage: Fully opaque panel for popovers, sheets and modals, and text on `exposed`.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Raised controls on a panel: idle tiles, secondary buttons, inactive segments, hover rows.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline frames and dividers on `panel` and `raised` (14% text). Decorative only; never the sole sign of state.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Frames that carry meaning: focusable controls, open slots, dashed placeholders (40% text; 3:1 on `panel` and `raised`).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers on `panel`, `panel-solid`, `raised` and `ground`. Barely-pink white, never pure white in the base theme.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text (78%) on `panel`, `raised`, `ground`: role lines, metadata, descriptions.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text (65%, the floor) on `panel`, `raised`, `ground`: hints, units, timestamps. Never lower.

tokens.name: on-cta
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `cta`, `exposed` or selected-segment fill.

tokens.name: ally
tokens.usage: Your fighters: rings, rail frames, ally health fill, ally telegraphs. Always paired with a circle. As text, on `panel` and `raised`.

tokens.name: ally-text
tokens.usage: Ally names, 'IN TEAM', heals and teal numbers on `panel`, `raised`, `ally-soft`.

tokens.name: ally-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind ally text: in-team tiles, selected portrait wells, the autopilot switch track.

tokens.name: enemy
tokens.usage: Opposing fighters: health fill, diamonds, enemy telegraph edges. Always paired with a diamond. As text only on `panel` (5.8:1); on `raised` use `enemy-text`.

tokens.name: enemy-text
tokens.usage: Enemy names and numbers on `panel`, `raised`, `enemy-soft`.

tokens.name: enemy-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind enemy text: enemy portrait wells, danger toasts.

tokens.name: power
tokens.usage: The shared Power pool: the strip fill, cost marks, queue badges. Queued Power is the same colour, hatched.

tokens.name: power-text
tokens.usage: Power values, costs ('18 POWER') and queue labels on `panel`, `raised`, `power-soft`.

tokens.name: power-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind Power text: queue chips, the Power strip's empty track.

tokens.name: queued
tokens.usage: Queued actions. Always drawn as a 135° hatch at `hatch-pitch`, never as a flat fill, so queued and spent never read alike.

tokens.name: cta
tokens.usage: The one primary action per screen (BATTLE, DONE): gradient start. Label in `on-cta`.

tokens.name: cta-2
tokens.usage: CTA gradient end (teal → mint, left to right).

tokens.name: danger-zone
tokens.usage: Enemy telegraphs and the pressure boundary, drawn as a 135° hatch at 35% over the ground.

tokens.name: badge-new
tokens.usage: The 'something new behind this button' diamond on rail buttons.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Latency 120–199 ms, unstable connection, soft-reserve warnings. As text on `panel`.

tokens.name: prop-hit
tokens.usage: The stop marker where an aimed shot meets breakable cover, and prop structure bars.

tokens.name: barrier
tokens.usage: Barrier overlay on health bars and the BARRIER status. Pale cyan so it never reads as heal (teal) or Power (lavender).

tokens.name: heal
tokens.usage: Heal numbers and heal telegraphs.

tokens.name: exposed
tokens.usage: The EXPOSED status: an inverted fill (`exposed` ground, `on-cta` text) so the most dangerous state is the loudest chip.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard and controller focus: a solid 2px frame in `focus` with a 2px `ground` gap. 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: tier-grey
tokens.usage: Normal items. As text and frame on `panel`.

tokens.name: tier-blue
tokens.usage: Rare fighters; Magic items; the blue summon tint.

tokens.name: tier-violet
tokens.usage: Epic fighters; Rare items; the violet summon tint. Bluer than `power` so the two never meet as equals.

tokens.name: tier-lime
tokens.usage: Set items (always with the set glyph).

tokens.name: tier-gold
tokens.usage: Legendary fighters; Unique items; the gold summon tint and god-ray burst.

tokens.name: kit-aria
tokens.usage: Aria's cloth, bow glow and lineup rim. From her concept sheet (cyan).

tokens.name: kit-sol
tokens.usage: Sol's cloth and lineup rim (solar amber). Proposed.

tokens.name: kit-rook
tokens.usage: Rook's cloth and lineup rim (coral). Proposed.

tokens.name: kit-hex
tokens.usage: Hex's cloth and lineup rim (magenta-violet). Proposed.

tokens.name: kit-aegis
tokens.usage: Aegis' cloth and lineup rim (periwinkle steel). Proposed.

tokens.name: kit-mira
tokens.usage: Mira's cloth and lineup rim (chartreuse). Proposed.

tokens.name: kit-echo
tokens.usage: Echo's cloth, disc glow and lineup rim. From her concept sheet (mint green).

tokens.name: kit-nyra
tokens.usage: Nyra's cloth, staff glow and lineup rim. From her concept sheet (violet).

tokens.name: scene-rim
tokens.usage: Character rim light in lobby and team scenes; blended 50/50 with the fighter's `kit-*` tint.

tokens.name: scene-ground
tokens.usage: Arena floor albedo under the tactical camera.

tokens.name: scene-fog
tokens.usage: Distance fog and the fade the HUD panels sit on; matched to the menu backdrop.

tokens.name: scene-neon
tokens.usage: Architectural neon strips and street lamps in the arena; never on a fighter.

tokens.name: holo
tokens.usage: Holographic lines: lineup platforms, grid floors, scan sweeps. Drawn at 25–60% over the scene.

tokens.name: holo-frame
tokens.usage: Holo accents on the plum panels (85% teal, after the main-menu concept): corner brackets on panels and selected rows, the hover frame of buttons, and the AR HUD chrome. Decorative; state still needs `line-strong`, a fill or text.

tokens.name: glass-sheen
tokens.usage: The light catching the top of a panel: a vertical fade from the top edge to clear at half height, over `panel`. Off in both themes since the main-menu concept, whose panels are flat translucent near-black; kept so a theme can turn it back on.

tokens.name: halo
tokens.usage: Projector bleed around holo strokes: two soft strokes along a panel's frame (8% teal). Off in the contrast theme.

tokens.name: scan
tokens.usage: Scanlines inside panels at `scan-pitch`, within `scan-alpha`. Off in both themes since the main-menu concept; kept so a theme can turn it back on.

tokens.name: visor-rim
tokens.usage: Retired with the visor look (2026-10-23, back to the original screen designs): clear in both themes, kept so existing USS contracts resolve.

tokens.name: visor-glare
tokens.usage: Retired with the visor look (2026-10-23, back to the original screen designs): clear in both themes, kept so existing USS contracts resolve.

tokens.name: signal-pink
tokens.usage: Brand signal in the intro splash: the slash-cut blade flash and wordmark accent. Never a gameplay colour.

tokens.name: splash-ground
tokens.usage: Intro splash backdrop behind the mark, one step darker than `panel-solid` so the blade reads first.

tokens.name: glitch-red
tokens.usage: Red projection channel during heads-up transitions.

tokens.name: glitch-cyan
tokens.usage: Cyan projection channel during heads-up transitions; rare perks.

styles.name: badge

groups.name: Text

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Fires three projectiles in a 12° spread.

groups.name: Readout

styles.name: readout-label
styles.usage: Panel headers in the visor (top-left of a frame, followed by a rule).

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Telemetry lines, captions and button labels.

glow.note: Filters for cut shapes (a box-shadow would be clipped). Glow budget: the CTA and the selected thing. Off in High contrast and Reduce flashing.

tokens.usage: The one CTA per screen.

tokens.name: glow-ally
tokens.usage: The selected fighter and the aiming ability.

tokens.name: glow-power
tokens.usage: A queued ability firing at its mark; the Power strip while filling past a mark.

tokens.name: glow-enemy
tokens.usage: Rejected actions and incoming signature telegraph labels.

tokens.name: glow-gold
tokens.usage: Legendary reveals only.

tokens.name: text-halo

fx.note: Sci-fi HUD effect parameters. Every effect is subtle enough to switch off without losing information.

tokens.name: scan-pitch
tokens.usage: Scanline period on holo surfaces.

tokens.name: scan-alpha
tokens.usage: Scanline opacity inside panels (the `scan` colour). Never above 0.08; 0.03 since 2026-10-23, when the flat original-design panels took back a faint layer of the visor glass.

tokens.name: hatch-pitch
tokens.usage: Period of the queued and danger hatch (2px line, 135°).

tokens.name: grid-pitch
tokens.usage: Holo floor grid and menu backdrop grid.

tokens.name: bracket-length
tokens.usage: Arm length of corner brackets on the square corners.

tokens.name: chroma-offset
tokens.usage: Red/cyan split on holo text during the flicker-in. 0 with Reduce flashing.

tokens.name: holo-tilt
tokens.usage: Maximum pointer-parallax tilt of 3D menu panels, and the visor wrap's steepest keystone. 0 with Reduced motion.

tokens.name: grain-alpha
tokens.usage: Film grain over menu backdrops only; never over the battle HUD.

tokens.name: visor-curve
tokens.usage: Visor wrap: how much taller a panel's outer edge is than its inner edge at the screen edge (fraction of its size, never more than `visor-keystone-max`). Panels at the centre stay square. Off (0) since 2026-10-23: the screens are flat panels again, as in the original designs.

tokens.name: visor-keystone-max
tokens.usage: Cap on the visor wrap's outer-edge growth, so big sheets do not lean.

tokens.name: visor-fringe
tokens.usage: Red/blue split of the projected UI at the visor corners (grows with the square of the distance from centre). 0 with Reduce flashes; desktop tiers only (M_VisorFilter.mat). Off (0) since 2026-10-23: the screens are flat panels again, as in the original designs.

tokens.name: visor-bloom
tokens.usage: Strength of the projector bloom the visor filter adds around bright strokes and text. Desktop tiers only (M_VisorFilter.mat). Off (0) since 2026-10-23: the screens are flat panels again, as in the original designs.

tokens.name: visor-bezel
tokens.usage: Depth of the helmet bezel at the top corners of the view (board units). Off (0) since 2026-10-23: the screens are flat panels again, as in the original designs.

tokens.name: visor-barrel
tokens.usage: The visor's barrel curve, shared by the camera (VisorLensFeature), the UI (VisorFilter) and input (VisorLens): the centre is magnified by 1 + this, the rim compressed, the four corners fixed. Desktop tiers only; 0 (flat) on the mobile tiers. Off (0) since 2026-10-23: the screens are flat panels again, as in the original designs.

tokens.name: visor-falloff
tokens.usage: How much the projected UI dims toward the visor rim (0..1). Off (0) since 2026-10-23: the screens are flat panels again, as in the original designs.

tokens.name: visor-focus-blur
tokens.usage: Focal blur radius of UI toward the rim and away from the pointer (the eye follows the pointer). Board units at full defocus. Off (0) since 2026-10-23: the screens are flat panels again, as in the original designs.

tokens.name: visor-focus-fringe
tokens.usage: Extra red/blue split of defocused UI (toward the rim, away from the pointer). Board units at full defocus; 0 with Reduce flashes. Off (0) since 2026-10-23: the screens are flat panels again, as in the original designs.

tokens.name: loader-turn
tokens.usage: Degrees the icosahedron loader turns counter-clockwise each time an edge finishes lighting.

tokens.name: alpha-panel
tokens.usage: Panel solidity over the scene.

tokens.name: alpha-telegraph
tokens.usage: Telegraph fill; the edge stays at full strength.

tokens.name: alpha-predicted
tokens.usage: Client-predicted marks (dashed) before the server confirms.

tokens.name: alpha-defeated
tokens.usage: Defeated fighters' portraits, with a struck-through name.

layer.note: Back to front. World layers are render order in Unity; HUD layers are z-index.

tokens.name: layer-telegraph

tokens.name: layer-entity

tokens.name: layer-vfx

tokens.name: layer-world-label
tokens.usage: Name tags, aim chips, combat text.

tokens.name: layer-hud

tokens.name: layer-popover

tokens.name: layer-modal

duration.note: Fast and ease-out. Reduced motion keeps fades only.

tokens.usage: Press scale to .96 (with a light haptic).

tokens.name: dur-ui

tokens.name: dur-pan-in

tokens.name: dur-zoom-out

tokens.name: dur-crossfade
tokens.usage: Animation crossfades and screen-to-screen fades.

tokens.name: dur-zoom-in
tokens.usage: Camera zoom-in.

tokens.name: dur-summon
tokens.usage: Rift portal charge before the burst.

tokens.name: dur-label-hold
tokens.usage: How long a prop's structure bar stays after a hit.

tokens.name: dur-change

tokens.name: dur-loader-edge

tokens.name: dur-loader-turn

tokens.name: dur-glitch-out

tokens.name: dur-wave-slam
tokens.usage: The wave number lands from 2.4 scale; the one sanctioned overshoot.

tokens.usage: Default for everything (ease-out cubic).

tokens.name: ease-in-out
